covered_report_window.plain_language: After the Wednesday, September 30, 2026 U.S. market close through before the Thursday, October 1, 2026 U.S. market open

market_context_summary: Cooler-than-expected August PCE helped the S&P 500 and Nasdaq while Treasury yields eased, but the 10-year yield had just touched a 24-year high and oil/Middle East risk remained an important valuation and input-cost overhang.

excluded_examples: ANGO: official timing not located; calendar timing estimated
PKE and VFS: thin/special-situation or weak timing/evidence quality

top_setups.note: Only two evidence-qualified downside calls were available; no third bearish setup was forced.

methodology.disparity_scale: 0-100; composite of normalized pass-score spread, reversal-risk spread, and call-band disagreement
methodology.learned_lessons_update: Applied existing key-metric-first, priced-in-growth, and low-bar reversal-risk rules; no new method change.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Leverage, integration cost, cautious FY27 tone
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Priced-in growth penalty; no new method change
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Management already indicated Q3 revenue and non-GAAP EPS should land at or above the prior guidance high end, so credible Domo economics and durable recurring revenue can support upside.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $1.52-$1.55 adjusted EPS and $248-$252M revenue; the real bar is Domo integration and the forward guide.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: High-end-or-better Q3 plus an accretive Domo roadmap and stable ARR/NRR.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Debt-funded integration, weaker organic ARR, or conservative FY27 commentary eclipses the beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 12.3%, a demanding hurdle; five covering analysts were reported as Buy-rated, raising the expectations bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published consensus sits near the top of prior guidance after management's July preannouncement; clean incremental revisions were not consistently available.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AIS growth and margin expansion provide a positive mix tailwind, provided ABL demand stabilizes and adjusted margins hold without one-off help.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Roughly $5.6 adjusted EPS and $1.25B revenue; the decisive metric is AIS growth/margin against ABL demand.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AIS sustains mid-teens growth and ABL steadies, supporting constructive FY27 commentary.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ABL remains weak or margin quality fades as favorable items normalize.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 8.8%; recent one-day reactions were much larger in both directions, so path risk remains meaningful.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public revision evidence was mixed and not strong enough to drive the call; the thesis rests on segment mix and execution.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-09-30 after market close (4:30 p.m. ET call)
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Extreme memory pricing, HBM demand, and customer commitments favor another strong print, but the stock needs FY27 guidance to clear an unusually elevated real-world bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $31.5-$32.3 adjusted EPS and $50.9-$52.1B revenue versus company guidance of $31 and $50B; FY27 margin durability matters more than Q4 EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY27 revenue and gross margin clear whispers while HBM4/customer-agreement visibility extends the cycle.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line beat, heavier capex, or any sign of margin peaking triggers sell-the-news.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 6.8%-8%; MU has historically moved about 9% on recent reports, while bullish retail/analyst positioning and visible downside hedges show crowding both ways.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimates rose materially into the print and buy ratings remain broad, making published consensus less useful than the elevated whisper bar.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-01 before market open (8:00 a.m. ET call)
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Acquisition-led headline growth masks modest 1%-3% organic growth, leaving the stock vulnerable if volume/mix or margin fails to validate a durable consumer recovery.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.76 EPS and $1.98B revenue; organic sales and margin quality matter more than acquisition-inflated headline growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Volume/mix improves and CCI savings protect margin despite commodities and integration spending.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Pricing carries weak volumes while commodity, interest, or integration costs squeeze the guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Vendor estimates conflict, ranging from about 4% to 8.4%; the uncertainty lowers confidence in the magnitude benchmark.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus implies only modest underlying growth; robust current revision counts were not consistently available.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-01 before market open (8:00 a.m. ET call)
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q3 bookings fell and FY26 growth guidance narrowed, so anything short of convincing FY27 organic growth and AI-bookings acceleration risks another negative reaction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $3.18 EPS and $18.0B revenue; bookings and FY27 growth guidance dominate headline EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Advanced-AI bookings accelerate and FY27 organic growth guidance signals a clean reacceleration.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Bookings stay soft and federal exposure, utilization, or AI disruption weighs on FY27 growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7.5%-8.1%; the 2026 drawdown and compressed valuation materially raise relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The prior quarter narrowed FY26 local-currency growth to 3%-4% after bookings fell 3% in local currency, leaving the forward bar cautious but low.
